description: This file defines the CandidateDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set the 'added person' of a candidate by ID and to retrieve the formatted date of application. The class uses traits for ORM helper functions and date-time formatting, and it interacts with Candidate and Employee entity classes.

classes.name: CandidateDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the Candidate entity, providing additional methods and logic for handling candidate-related data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Candidate object.

methods.name: setAddedPersonById
methods.description: Sets the 'added person' for the candidate based on a given employee ID.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted date of application for the candidate.
